gpt-4-turbo.note: Pin via model= field in OpenAI API call. Snapshot gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 was the deployed version at benchmark run time.

meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct.note: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct. Only 1 evaluation run in current dataset — insufficient for significance.

mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3.note: Mistral 7B v0.3. DPO + SFT with helpfulness-first objective. Exhibits highest P1 severity risk (83.3%).

claude-3-sonnet.note: Claude 3 Sonnet. Not yet evaluated in v1 dataset — included for planned Phase 2 runs.
